Name: Younger Pam
Author: Riazaia
Description:
[size=3]Made Pam look a little more like my personal headcanon of her. Has a couple of config options for hair length and saturation level of the character sprites so you can pick what matches your game better.

A config will be created when you run your game once.
The config options are [b]Long[/b] or [b]Short[/b] for PamHair and [b]Desat[/b] or [b]Sat[/b] for Recolor.[/size]

Enjoy!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Younger Pam
Manifest.Description: Makes Pam's portrait and sprite look younger.
